$schema.description: The address of this file's JSON Schema, for editors.

defaultProject.description: The project key used to scope results to the specificed project board when no explicit key is given. Local setting overrides the global one. An explicitly given key in a command overrides both.

directory.description: The Zinn directory, which holds data/zinn.sqlite and backups/. A relative path is relative to the folder of this file, and a leading ~ means your home folder. ZINN_DIR, when set, takes precedence.

telemetry.description: Whether Zinn records local usage measurements, and how much space they may use.

mode.description: off collects nothing. local records command usage in the telemetry folder of the Zinn directory and sends nothing off this machine. Defaults to local, or to off when the DO_NOT_TRACK environment variable is 1. A value here overrides DO_NOT_TRACK.

maxMegabytes.description: The most disk space, in whole megabytes of 1,048,576 bytes, that the telemetry folder may use. Defaults to 100.

hooks.description: Commands Zinn runs after each saved change, one after another in the order listed. Read only from the global settings file. zinn.local.json cannot set them.

command.description: The command to run through the platform shell after each saved change. It gets the change's activity records on stdin, one JSON object per line.

timeout.description: Seconds the hook may run before it is stopped with a warning. Defaults to 30.

additionalProperties.description: One hook, named by its key.
